flow-definition.description: Deploy pipeline for metabuilder. Pulls the app images published by metabuilder-apps from the registry, retags them to the local deployment-<svc>:latest names the compose stack expects, then brings the stack up via deployment.py. Build/deploy split: this never builds images. Auto-triggered after metabuilder-apps (threshold UNSTABLE, so an UNSTABLE apps build still deploys what was pushed).

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: IMAGE_TAG
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Image tag to pull from the registry: latest, or a specific git short sha.
